name: Advertisement JavaScript content
description: Adds an advertisement type that supports running JavaScript. WIP!
project_description: Advertisement JavaScript content is an experimental (WIP) submodule of the Advertisement (ad) project that adds a javascript_ad advertisement bundle whose field_javascript holds JavaScript code intended to render network/third-party ads. As shipped the rendering hook is commented out, so the type stores code but does not yet execute it. Depends on ad_content and core text.
